intro: Markers for saying it again, correcting yourself, giving an example and changing the subject.
p.es decir.consejo: It follows a hard idea and explains it another way. It takes commas.
p.o sea.consejo: It is very spoken: used a lot in conversation. In writing, «es decir» is better.
p.en otras palabras.consejo: «Palabras» is feminine plural, hence «otras». It is more formal than «o sea».
p.mejor dicho.consejo: Use it to correct yourself: «llega hoy, mejor dicho, mañana». The j sounds like h.
p.en concreto.consejo: It follows something general: «quiero viajar, en concreto, a Perú».
p.de hecho.consejo: The h is silent: «de hecho» sounds like «de echo». It backs up what you said before.
p.en realidad.consejo: It is the English «actually». Do not mix it up with «actualmente», which means «now».
p.por cierto.consejo: It brings in a topic you have just remembered. A synonym is «a propósito».
p.en fin.consejo: It closes a topic with a sigh: «en fin, qué le vamos a hacer». It is very spoken.
p.pues.consejo: It is very common at the start of an answer: «pues, no sé». It buys thinking time.
p.ya.consejo: Said alone and short, «ya» means «I get it». It also means «already».
p.actualmente.consejo: It is a false friend: not «actually». «Actually» is «en realidad» or «de hecho».
b1.texto:
These markers help you steer a conversation:

- to explain again: **es decir**, **o sea**, **en otras palabras**
- to correct yourself: **mejor dicho**
- to give an exact case: **en concreto**
- to back up what you said with a fact: **de hecho**
- to set the record straight: **en realidad**
- to change the subject: **por cierto**
- to wrap up, a little resigned: **en fin**

In speech, **pues** and **ya** buy time and soften what follows.

Beware of the false friend **actualmente**: it means «now». «Actually» is **en realidad** or **de hecho**.
b2.f0.texto: I am thinking of leaving my job.
b2.f1.texto: Or rather, I want to change companies.
b2.f2.texto: In other words, you are not happy.
b2.f4.texto: I work almost every Saturday, that is, I never rest.
b2.f6.texto: By the way, my company is looking for someone.
b2.f7.texto: Specifically, what position are they looking for?
b2.f8.texto: Currently they are looking for a sales manager.
b2.f9.texto: Anyway, tomorrow we will talk calmly.
b4.texto:
Each marker does a different job:

- **Saying it another way**: es decir, o sea, en otras palabras
- **Correcting yourself**: mejor dicho
- **Giving an exact case**: en concreto
- **Backing up with a fact**: de hecho
- **Setting things straight**: en realidad

All of them go at the start of the sentence and take a **comma**. «De hecho» adds; «en realidad» contradicts an impression.
b4.e0.texto: In fact, Ana is the best.
b4.e1.texto: In other words, he does not want to come.
b4.e2.texto: We currently live in a small city.
b5.f0.texto: On the café terrace, the afternoon sun draws long shadows.
b5.f1.texto: Two friends talk in low voices next to the fountain.
b5.f2.texto: One of them confesses that, in reality, she never wanted to leave.
b5.f3.texto: The other smiles and slowly stirs her coffee spoon.
b5.f4.texto: A warm breeze brings the smell of bread and flowers.
b5.f5.texto: At the moment the square smells of wet earth and warm bread.
b5.f6.texto: A group of children runs among the pigeons with their arms open.
b5.f7.texto: In fact, the noise of their laughter fills the whole street.
b5.f8.texto: The friends look at each other in silence and laugh.
b5.f9.texto: Anyway, the evening fades slowly over the red rooftops.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: it corrects what you have just said.
b6.o1.refuerzo: It backs up what you said with a fact; it does not correct.
b6.o2.refuerzo: It changes the subject; it corrects nothing.
b6.pregunta: Which marker is used to correct yourself?
b7.frase: Es muy buena. ____, es la mejor.
b7.o0.refuerzo: That is it: it adds a fact that backs up the previous idea.
b7.o1.refuerzo: It would change the subject, and here we keep the same idea.
b7.o2.refuerzo: It closes with resignation; here you want to reinforce.
b7.pregunta: Back up the first idea with a stronger one.
b8.frase: En realidad me gusta lo que hago
b8.traduccion: Actually I like what I do
b9.o0.refuerzo: That would be «actually». In Spanish it is «en realidad».
b9.o2.refuerzo: «Al final» is «in the end». It is unrelated.
b11.frase: En ____ palabras, no estás de acuerdo.
b11.o1.refuerzo: It is masculine. «Palabras» needs the feminine: «otras».
b11.o2.refuerzo: It is singular. «Palabras» is plural, so «otras».
b12.o0.refuerzo: It explains the same thing again; it does not change the subject.
b12.o1.refuerzo: It gives an exact case of the same subject.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Correct: it brings in something you have just remembered.
b12.pregunta: You change the subject suddenly. Which marker do you use?
p.ventas.consejo: The v sounds like b: «ventas» is said BEN-tas.
p.confiesa.consejo: From «confesar», to confess. The ie forms a diphthong: kon-FIE-sa.
p.quiso.consejo: From «querer», to want. The qu is always k: KI-so.
p.palomas.consejo: Plural of «paloma». The stress falls on LO: pa-LO-mas.
p.abiertos.consejo: Plural of «abierto», open. The ie is a diphthong: a-BIER-tos.
